# Command

> Command palette with token-matched dialog, input, and result rows.

This file matches the installed `command` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/command.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/command.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `cmdk@^1.1.1`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `dialog`
- `empty`
- `live-status`
- `scroll-area`
- `surface-variants`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/popup-knobs`: `popupKnobs`, types `PopupKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/command`: `Command`, `CommandDialog`, `CommandInput`, `CommandList`, `CommandEmpty`, `CommandLoading`, `CommandGroup`, `CommandSeparator`, `CommandItem`, `CommandItemContent`, `CommandItemTitle`, `CommandItemDescription`, `CommandShortcut`, types `CommandChrome`, `CommandProps`, `CommandDialogProps`, `CommandInputProps`, `CommandListProps`, `CommandEmptyProps`, `CommandLoadingProps`, `CommandGroupProps`, `CommandSeparatorProps`, `CommandItemProps`, `CommandItemContentProps`, `CommandItemTitleProps`, `CommandItemDescriptionProps`, `CommandShortcutProps`

## Composition

### Inline command list

```tsx
<Command>
  <CommandInput />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandLoading />
    <CommandEmpty />
    <CommandGroup>
      <CommandItem>
        <CommandShortcut />
      </CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
    <CommandSeparator />
  </CommandList>
</Command>
```

### Item with description

CommandItemContent stacks a truncating title over a muted description; the row keeps its icon and shortcut.

```tsx
<CommandItem>
  icon
  <CommandItemContent>
    <CommandItemTitle />
    <CommandItemDescription />
  </CommandItemContent>
  <CommandShortcut />
</CommandItem>
```

### Command palette dialog

CommandDialog supplies the dialog and Command root.

```tsx
<CommandDialog>
  <CommandInput />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty />
    <CommandGroup>
      <CommandItem />
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</CommandDialog>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react";

import {
  Command,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
  CommandSeparator,
  CommandShortcut,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/command";
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveCommandExample() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <Command>
        <CommandInput placeholder="Type a command or search…" />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty />
          <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
            <CommandItem value="new-thread">
              New thread
              <CommandShortcut>
                <KbdGroup>
                  <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
                  <Kbd>N</Kbd>
                </KbdGroup>
              </CommandShortcut>
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem value="search-docs">Search docs</CommandItem>
            <CommandItem value="invite">Invite teammate</CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
          <CommandSeparator />
          <CommandGroup heading="Pages">
            <CommandItem value="settings profile">
              <Text tone="muted">Settings</Text>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Profile</span>
              <CommandShortcut>
                <KbdGroup>
                  <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
                  <Kbd>,</Kbd>
                </KbdGroup>
              </CommandShortcut>
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem value="settings workspace members">
              <Text tone="muted">Settings</Text>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
              <Text tone="muted">Workspace</Text>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Members</span>
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem value="settings billing invoices">
              <Text tone="muted">Settings</Text>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
              <Text tone="muted">Billing</Text>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Invoices</span>
            </CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
        </CommandList>
      </Command>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `command`
  - `dialog-root`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `empty`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `group`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `input`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `input-icon`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `input-wrapper`: `data-focus-ring` (`none`), `data-popup-kind` (`command`), `data-size` (`lg`)
  - `item`: `data-disabled`, `data-popup-kind` (`command`), `data-selected` (`false` | `true`)
  - `item-content`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `item-description`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `item-title`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `list`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `loading`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `root`: `data-chrome` (`embedded` | `standalone`), `data-popup-kind` (`command`), `data-popup-static`
  - `separator`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)
  - `shortcut`: `data-popup-kind` (`command`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### popup

- `--cui-popup-title-foreground`: `var(--cui-popup-foreground)`
- `--cui-popup-title-font-size`: `var(--text-heading-3)`
- `--cui-popup-title-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-semibold)`
- `--cui-popup-title-line-height`: `var(--text-heading-3--line-height)`
- `--cui-popup-title-letter-spacing`: `-0.025em`
- `--cui-popup-description-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-popup-description-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-popup-close-inset`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-popup-item-inset`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 8)`
- `--cui-popup-label-padding-block`: `var(--cui-popup-item-padding-block)`
